{{Top}}
The '''Code of Ammuud''' was the governing law on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ammuud/Legends|Ammuud]], instituted by the seven clans after warfare nearly destroyed their world. The Code regulated the actions of the clans and individuals, including when and where violence and revenge was allowed to be enacted, usually resulting in a duel that settled matters.
